title: Uniform dimension bound for fibres of a finite-type morphism
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and assume $Y$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. There exists an integer $d\geq0$ such that for every point $y\in Y$ the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_y$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $d$. Empty fibres are allowed and have dimension $-\infty$.
